name: Crest of Lordaeron
summary: In the ruins of Capital City, a weathered Crest of Lordaeron survives from the fallen northern kingdom. Relics like it are scarce, and Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City is eager to claim one.

sections.title: A Shattered Heritage
sections.body: The Scourge left Lordaeron's palaces and archives in ruins beneath the shadow of the Undercity. Its proud insignias were destroyed or left to decay, so few relics bearing the royal crest remain. A weathered crest from the northern ruins keeps a piece of human history.

sections.title: Refuge in the South
sections.body: After the Third War, thousands of refugees fled south from Lordaeron toward the Kingdom of Stormwind. They carried memories of home. In Stormwind City, Lady Dena Kennedy seeks remnants of their homeland. For those who left the north behind, a crest like this is a cherished link to Lordaeron.

faq.q: What is the Crest of Lordaeron?
faq.answer: The Crest of Lordaeron is a weathered emblem bearing the kingdom's official mark. It survived the Scourge's fall of Lordaeron and remains a historical relic for human survivors.

faq.q: Who wants the Crest of Lordaeron?
aliases: where do i bring crest of lordaeron
faq.answer: Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City wants the crest. She collects and preserves rare artifacts from Lordaeron.
The crest was recovered from the Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades. The ruined capital lies above the Undercity, the Forsaken stronghold.

faq.q: Why are artifacts from Lordaeron so rare?
faq.answer: Few Lordaeron artifacts survived the kingdom's swift fall during the Third War. The Scourge slaughtered its people and ruined its estates, while the Forsaken rose in the north.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind care about relics of Lordaeron?
faq.answer: Stormwind welcomed refugees, knights, and nobles fleeing Lordaeron's devastation. Preserving its relics honors the fallen northern kingdom and keeps its human heritage alive.
Lady Dena Kennedy is a noblewoman in Stormwind City who seeks to salvage heirlooms and other historical remnants of Lordaeron.

angles.text: As a human, especially if your family came from the north, the crest recalls the great kingdom that once led the Alliance.
As an Alliance member, you can see Lordaeron's emblem as a mark of the Alliance's founding. Recovering it keeps the Scourge and Forsaken from erasing that symbol.

attribution: In-game quest text: Crest of Lordaeron
